60100: Resets the Winsock Catalog to a clean state.
60101:
Usage: %1!s!
 
Remarks: Resets Winsock Catalog to a clean state. 
         All Winsock Layered Service Providers which were previously
         installed must be reinstalled.
         This command does not affect Winsock Name Space Provider
         entries.
60103:
Usage: %1!s!
 
Remarks: Displays Winsock Catalog entries.
60104: Shows the audit trail of Layered Service Providers that have been installed and uninstalled.
60105:
Usage: %1!s!
 
Remarks: Shows the audit trail of Layered Service Providers that have been installed
         and uninstalled.
60106: Removes a Winsock LSP from the system.
60107:
Usage: %1!s! <catalog id>
 

Remarks: Removes a Winsock LSP from the system.
60108: Sets Winsock options for the system.
60109:
Usage: autotuning  on | off
 

Remarks: Autotuning enables dynamic send buffering for overall better throughput.
60110: Displays whether Winsock send autotuning is enabled.
60111:
Remarks: Displays whether Winsock send autotuning is enabled.
 

Send autotuning is dynamically adjust the amount of send buffered per 
socket connection based upon the amount of data that can be sustained 
by the network.
